decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the established portfolio and publicly presented on its own page, it carries visible commitment and sunk development and launch costs that management is likely to defend.

Although it is more distant from the established offer, the firm has still made a public market commitment with a dedicated page and the product is too recent for management to readily concede a misstep.
This product line is close to the core business, involves several models, and has been given its own page, so high investment and strong public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.

The supplement appears less strongly committed than the prescription launches because it is only mentioned on the website, but it fits the stated push into differentiated health products and is still recent enough to be retained.
